summary: Cloud Run service instances can allocate up to 4 vCPUs.
extended_definition: Cloud Run service instances can allocate up to 4 vCPUs.

supporting_pages.title: Container runtime contract \_|\_ Cloud Run \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: The following sections describe resources for your container instance: CPU Memory GPU Concurrency CPU Each Cloud Run container in an instance by default gets allocated the vCPU that has been configured (1 by default).
If you have configured a number of minimum instances , you must use instance-based billing so that CPU is allocated outside of requests .
If you select request-based billing (default), CPU is allocated when instances are processing requests.
